claimChecks.claim: At least two venous anastomoses are a universal technical minimum
claimChecks.locator: Falcone abstract Results and Yuan indexed Methods/Results anastomosis counts
claimChecks.note: Falcone association limited to 25; Yuan had four single-vein cases without vascular event among 38 free flaps. Reliable outflow remains essential.

claimChecks.claim: Doppler changes donor choice in 39% of all RFFF/phalloplasty candidates and a zero-event Allen series makes testing unnecessary
claimChecks.locator: Original abstracts Methods/Results, 87 oral-cancer and 237 retrospective flap populations
claimChecks.note: 39% population specified; rare ischemia cannot be excluded by 237 zero events, and hand perfusion still needs assessment.

claimChecks.claim: 2025 review proves pALT shorter at 290 versus 516 minutes and RFFF is universally best
claimChecks.locator: Netshiongolwe abstract Results/Conclusion and evidence-quality statements
claimChecks.note: Internal minute-order discrepancy flagged for full-table access; selection bias and low GRADE prevent universal ranking.

claimChecks.claim: Wang's RFFF stricture rate is significantly higher and defines a universal flap-risk ranking
claimChecks.locator: Original abstract Results: 57 total, stricture P=0.24
claimChecks.note: Single-center retrospective context and nonsignificant stricture comparison stated.

claimChecks.claim: Integra plus STSG is proven the superior routine donor closure
claimChecks.locator: Falcone abstract Results and Marquez Methods/Results Tables 1–4 and limitations
claimChecks.note: Retained Falcone's observed group data; added 15-person comparison with two STSG-only patients and no patient-reported/volume advantage, without asserting equivalence.

claimChecks.claim: Optional shaft-only, appendix and nonmicrosurgical variants have proven comparative efficacy
claimChecks.locator: Original technical abstracts and page reference 21 two-case title
claimChecks.note: Variants preserved as selected technical reports rather than universal risk or feasibility guarantees.
